bottleneck_analysis.bottleneck_notes: The largest likely bottleneck is validation and repository indexing across thousands of SVG files, not the download step itself.
improvement_candidates: Add incremental collection by source and variant.
Add manifest diffing so unchanged source archives do not regenerate every file.
Add gallery pagination or lazy loading if the single-page gallery becomes slow.
Add a public-release license checklist before publishing the repository.
